source_read: https://www.prezzo.co.uk/allergens/ (fresh download 2026-10-08, byte-identical to the copy saved earlier today, sha256 a109dbed; robots.txt only disallows /umbraco and /Api). Read independently by rendering the live page in Chromium and opening every item's own panel (531 cards incl. the 'Prezzo favourite' cards).
notes: 426 of 428 rows in items.csv (including the 9 earlier held-back ones) equal the rendered panel on all 8 printed nutrients (calories, fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, protein, salt, fibre), and for all 426 the panel's 'Contains / May contain' text equals allergens.csv and the V/VG badge equals the vegetarian tag (0 differences); the other 2 are the held-back duplicate Margherita / Meat Lovers rows the page cannot tell apart (its panel shows the first row for both). Script re-run on the fresh page reproduces the CSVs. Held back Custard Cream Tiramisu (description layers custard and mascarpone, page marks no egg, not even may-contain). 20 audit flags marked ok after reading the panels (sharers are whole 3-4 person dishes and 4P+4C+9F matches; fusilli/cake/crumb rows carry the GF badge; Baby Caesar is marked vegetarian so the Caesar dressing carries no anchovy; salty vegan pepperoni pizzas are consistent with their siblings).
